services.name: CPAC Rentals
services.desc: The Cowichan Performing Arts Centre Presenting Season is a series that features national and international performances of artistic excellence curated by the CVRD’s Arts & Culture Manager, Patrick LeBlanc. In the upcoming season, you will find exciting shows for all interests, including internationally acclaimed musicians, award winning theatre, inspiring dance, and family friendly performances. The CPAC Presenting Series strives to present shows that are accessible and diverse, where communities can come together in shared, meaningful experiences. Become a subscriber and receive information about upcoming shows, ticket deals, VIP packages, and so much more! The Cowichan Performing Arts
